import sys

import zipfile

import base64

_B64_ALPHABET = frozenset(
    'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/')


def is_valid_path(path):
    if not isinstance(path, str):
        return False
    if path == '':
        return False
    if path.startswith('/'):
        return False
    if '\\' in path:
        return False
    for part in path.split('/'):
        if part == '' or part == '.' or part == '..':
            return False
    return True


def is_valid_base64(s):
    if not isinstance(s, str):
        return False
    n = len(s)
    if n % 4 != 0:
        return False
    i = n
    while i > 0 and s[i - 1] == '=':
        i -= 1
    pad = n - i
    if pad > 2:
        return False
    stripped = s[:i]
    if stripped and any(c not in _B64_ALPHABET for c in stripped):
        return False
    if len(stripped) % 4 == 1:
        return False
    try:
        base64.b64decode(s, validate=True)
    except Exception:
        return False
    return True


def validate_request(request):
    if not isinstance(request, dict):
        return False
    if set(request.keys()) != {"members", "timestamp", "comment"}:
        return False

    members = request["members"]
    if not isinstance(members, list):
        return False
    if not (1 <= len(members) <= 64):
        return False

    paths = []
    for member in members:
        if not isinstance(member, dict):
            return False
        if set(member.keys()) != {"path", "content_b64", "mode"}:
            return False
        path = member["path"]
        content_b64 = member["content_b64"]
        mode = member["mode"]
        if not is_valid_path(path):

        if not is_valid_base64(content_b64):

        content = base64.b64decode(content_b64, validate=True)
        if len(content) > 64 * 1024:
            return False
        if not isinstance(mode, int) or isinstance(mode, bool):
            return False
        if not (0 <= mode <= 511):
            return False
        paths.append(path)

    if len(set(paths)) != len(paths):
        return False

    ts = request["timestamp"]
    if not isinstance(ts, list) or len(ts) != 6:
        return False
    if not all(isinstance(x, int) and not isinstance(x, bool) for x in ts):
        return False
    year, month, day, hour, minute, second = ts
    if not (1980 <= year <= 2107):
        return False
    if not (1 <= month <= 12):
        return False
    if not (1 <= day <= calendar.monthrange(year, month)[1]):
        return False
    if not (0 <= hour <= 23):
        return False
    if not (0 <= minute <= 59):
        return False
    if not (0 <= second <= 59):
        return False
    if second % 2 != 0:
        return False

    file_time = (hour << 6) | (minute << 1) | (second // 2)
